commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
90+10' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Denis Suarez (Alaves) duly receives a yellow card.
90+9' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+7' Although Yusi (Alaves) is just on the bench, Victor Garcia has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+7' 3 - 3 Denis Suarez passes to Lucas Boye (Alaves), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the top right corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 3:3.
90+6' Carles Alena (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

90+5' Abderrahmane Rebbach looks up and sends over a pin-point cross to Antonio Blanco (Alaves) near the penalty spot, but he totally fluffs his lines and plants a tame header well wide of the right post.
90+3' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) has to leave the pitch!
90+2' Pellegrino Matarazzo is stunned as referee Victor Garcia shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

90+2' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad), but referee Victor Garcia must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+1' The game is interrupted. Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Denis Suarez (Alaves) tries to find Victor Parada, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball has crossed the sideline. Real Sociedad are taking a throw-in.
89' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:5. The fouls committed statistics – 11:16.
89' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) sends a precise pass into the box, but Takefusa Kubo loses the one-on-one with the defender.
88' What a big chance! Toni Martinez (Alaves) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
86' Substitution. Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) in, Aritz Elustondo out.
86' Luka Sucic is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Luken Beitia (Real Sociedad).
86' Denis Suarez (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Angel Perez.
83' Lucas Boye (Alaves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Alex Remiro.
82' A pass from Lucas Boye (Alaves) is intercepted by Alex Remiro and the move breaks down.
81' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

80' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play and Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.

78' Carles Alena (Alaves) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
77' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves have a free kick.
77' The corner from Carles Alena (Alaves) is hurriedly cleared.

77' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It will be a corner kick for Alaves.
76' A snap shot from distance by Antonio Blanco (Alaves) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
76' Alaves hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
73' Carles Alena (Alaves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

73' Carles Alena (Alaves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
72' A substitution has been made. Orri Oskarsson is replaced by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad).
71' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
68' 10:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. Shots on target – 4:1.
66' Here is a change. Pablo Ibanez is going off and Quique Sanchez Flores gives the last tactical orders to Ander Guevara (Alaves).
66' Substitution. Jon Guridi makes way for Carles Alena (Alaves).
66' Angel Perez (Alaves) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
65' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Victor Parada (Alaves) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
64' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
60' 3 - 2 GOAL! Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) scores with a header from close range after Takefusa Kubo headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 3:2.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ibrahim Diabate walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lucas Boye (Alaves).
59' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card. Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) will miss the next game.
57' Wasted effort! Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.
57' Jon Aramburu almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
57' The attendance is 31024.
55' Angel Perez (Alaves) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
55' Angel Perez (Alaves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Alaves will have a corner.
54' The referee signals a substitution. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is brought on as a substitute for Brais Mendez.
53' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
52' Toni Martinez (Alaves) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
48' Alaves control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Pellegrino Matarazzo gives a chance to Goncalo Guedes and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is off.
46' The whistle blows and Victor Garcia starts the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Angel Perez (Alaves) but poses no threat.
45+3' Jon Guridi (Alaves) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
45+2' Angel Perez (Alaves) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Sociedad.
45+1' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner but it's cleared.

45+1' Angel Perez (Alaves) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Alaves.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
43' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.

41' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' It could have been a good chance to score! Antonio Blanco (Alaves) fails to release Jon Guridi with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
38' Jonny Otto (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
37' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).

36' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends the corner into the box, but Antonio Sivera intercepts it and averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.
36' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
34' Total attempts – 6:2. The current number of shots on goal is 3:1.
29' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

29' Good defending. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) tries to find Orri Oskarsson inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Real Sociedad.
27' What bad luck! Antonio Sivera (Alaves) sends the ball into his own net.
27' What a great touch by Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad)! He picks up a precise pass and produces a long-range shot, but his fabulous effort smashes off the right post!
27' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

27' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
26' Victor Garcia blows his whistle as Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
26' A pass from Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.

24' 1 - 2 The ball finds its way to Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) after a confusing situation inside the goalmouth. He finds some space and easily knocks the ball in with his body and alters the score to 1:2.
21' Toni Martinez (Alaves) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
21' The free kick is taken by Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves), but ball is cleared.

20' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Victor Garcia blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Free kick. Alaves will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
20' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) sends a long cross over to Brais Mendez, but Antonio Sivera comes forward to gather the ball.
18' A snap shot by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) from distance flies well wide of the right post.
17' 69:31 – the ratio of ball possession.
16' The resulting corner from Angel Perez (Alaves) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

14' 1 - 1 Nice piece of skill by Luka Sucic (Real Sociedad). He perfectly collected a pass from Ander Barrenetxea and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:1.
12' Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
12' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' Antonio Sivera comes off his line to intercept the corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad).

9' Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Sociedad will take a corner.
7' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
6' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner with a short pass.
5' Antonio Sivera makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) after a cross from the side.
5' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

5' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
4' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
3' 0 - 1 What bad luck! Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) got in the way of a pass and unintentionally sent the ball past his own goalkeeper. The score is 0:1.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Alaves will have the kick-off.
